entities.summary: Citra Febrianti is an Indonesian weightlifter who won the silver medal at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the –53 kg category. She originally finished fourth, but was promoted to second after gold medallist Zulfiya Chinshanlo and bronze medallist Cristina Iovu were both disqualified.
